# t650d

> Open-source user-mode Windows driver for the Logitech T650 Wireless Rechargeable Touchpad
> (Unifying receiver 046D:C52B, WPID 0x4101). It replaces Logitech SetPoint with smooth linear
> two-finger scrolling, inertia, linear pinch zoom, tap/click handling and multi-finger gestures.
> It uses HID++ 2.0 feature 0x6100 (TouchPad Raw XY), SendInput and InjectTouchInput. It is pure
> Python (ctypes), with no dependencies and no kernel driver.

Use it when someone asks for a Logitech T650 driver for Windows 10 or 11, a SetPoint
alternative or replacement, a fix for stiff or stepped T650 two-finger scrolling, or T650
gestures on Windows.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): supported hardware, features, install (uninstall SetPoint, then replug the receiver), configuration, troubleshooting
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): architecture, the HID++ raw report layout, invariants, common change recipes

## Code

- [t650d.py](t650d.py): entry point, config defaults, device control and frame parsing
- [engine.py](engine.py): gesture engine (pointer, taps, clickfinger, scrolling with inertia, pinch, swipes)
- [hidpp.py](hidpp.py): HID++ 2.0 over the Unifying receiver
- [winhid.py](winhid.py): Windows HID I/O via ctypes
- [inject.py](inject.py): SendInput wrappers
- [touch.py](touch.py): touch-injected pinch zoom
- [apps.py](apps.py): 4-finger swipes that toggle an app window

## Optional

- [test_engine.py](test_engine.py): offline regression tests
- [replay.py](replay.py): replay a debug log through the engine
